reference: Bahain, J.-J., Duval, M., Voinchet, P., Tissoux, H., Falguères, C., Grün, R., Moreno, D., Shao, Q., Tombret, O., Jamet, G., Faivre, J.-P., Cliquet, D. (2020). ESR and ESR/U-series chronology of the Middle Pleistocene site of Tourville-la-Rivière (Normandy, France) - A multi-laboratory approach. Quaternary International 556: 66-78. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.quaint.2019.06.015 (MNHN dataset, Table 4)

conventions.radon_loss: Determined by cross-checking HRGS and alpha-spectrometry data (Bahain et al. 1992); 222Rn/230Th per tissue given in Table 4
conventions.cosmic: Three-stage burial model based on Jamet (2015) geological interpretation, Prescott & Hutton 1988/1994; mean cosmic about 100 µGy/a (text); mean depth 14 ± 3 m estimated from chronostratigraphy (Table 4 footnote)
conventions.gamma_source: in situ NaI probe + Canberra Inspector 1000, threshold method; mean of 4 in situ measurements in layer D2: 417 ± 21 µGy/a (text); gamma+cosmic 517 ± 29 µGy/a in Table 4
conventions.sediment_radioelements: HRGS; used for beta dose only
conventions.software_detail: US ages: USESR (Shao et al. 2014); CSUS ages: DATA (Grün 2009)
conventions.De_fitting: SSE, 1/I^2 weighting, Dmax 5000 Gy, T1B2 peak-to-peak, Origin

completeness: partial: geometry/side of removed thicknesses not stated; Dβ not split into dentine/sediment; cosmic per sample not printed (text: ~100 µGy/a); water basis not stated ('% wgt')
extraction_notes: Table 4 read twice via WebFetch (raw text extraction and a CSV re-extraction with a different prompt); all numbers agreed. A third per-sample read conflated removed thickness (2) with depth -- rejected in favour of the raw layout (enamel line: '(1) x ± y', dentine line: '(2) x ± y', then 'Mean depth 14 ± 3'). US-ESR errors printed symmetric (±). U-series ratios printed as 234U/238U and 230Th/238U (stored as th230_u238; th230_u234 null). Table 7 gives recalculated De values (Dmax 1000 Gy) not used for these ages. | Dose-rate columns renamed after extraction: Dα + Dβ + γ+cosmic = printed total for every sample, so Dα is the enamel alpha dose rate ('alpha_internal') and Dβ all beta, internal included ('beta_all').
